about: National Weather Service (weather.gov / api.weather.gov): look up US forecasts by lat/lon or NWS grid point, active alerts, weather stations and their latest observations, forecast-office text products (e.g. Area Forecast Discussions), zone boundary KML, DWML forecast export, and weather glossary terms.

commands.summary: Resolve a lat/lon to its NWS forecast office, grid x/y, forecast URLs, forecast zone, county and nearby city. Run this first to get the wfo/x/y that the forecast commands take.

params.name: lat
params.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, at most 4 decimals, e.g. 39.7456

params.name: lon
params.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, at most 4 decimals. Negative for the western hemisphere, e.g. -97.0892

commands.summary: Get the 7-day forecast (day/night periods) for an NWS grid point (office + x,y from get-point).

params.name: wfo
params.description: Forecast office ID (gridId from get-point), e.g. TOP, BOU, MFL

params.name: x
params.description: Grid X (gridX from get-point)

params.name: y
params.description: Grid Y (gridY from get-point)

params.name: units
params.description: Unit system: us (imperial) or si (metric)

commands.summary: Get the hour-by-hour forecast (about 7 days) for an NWS grid point.

params.name: wfo
params.description: Forecast office ID (gridId from get-point), e.g. TOP

params.name: x
params.description: Grid X (gridX from get-point)

params.name: y
params.description: Grid Y (gridY from get-point)

params.name: units
params.description: Unit system: us (imperial) or si (metric)

commands.summary: List currently active NWS watches, warnings and advisories. Filter by state/marine area, zone, event type, severity or urgency.

params.name: area
params.description: State or marine area code, e.g. CO, FL, TX

params.name: zone
params.description: Forecast or county zone ID, e.g. COZ040 or COC031

params.name: event
params.description: Event name, e.g. 'Winter Storm Warning', 'Red Flag Warning'

params.name: severity
params.description: Alert severity

params.name: urgency
params.description: Alert urgency

commands.summary: List NWS observation stations, optionally filtered by state. Returns station IDs for get-latest-observation.

params.name: state
params.description: Two-letter state code, e.g. CO

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Maximum number of stations to return (max 500) (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.summary: Get the latest current-conditions observation from a station: temperature, dewpoint, wind, pressure, humidity and sky text.

params.name: station
params.description: Station ID (ICAO), e.g. KDEN, KMIA

commands.summary: List issued text products of one type from a forecast office, newest first (e.g. Area Forecast Discussions from BOU).

params.name: type
params.description: Product type code, e.g. AFD (Area Forecast Discussion), HWO (Hazardous Weather Outlook), ZFP (Zone Forecast Product)

params.name: office
params.description: Issuing office / location ID, e.g. BOU, MFL, TOP

commands.summary: Get the full text of the most recent product of a type from an office, e.g. the latest Area Forecast Discussion.

params.name: type
params.description: Product type code, e.g. AFD, HWO, ZFP

params.name: office
params.description: Issuing office / location ID, e.g. BOU

commands.summary: Export the point forecast as DWML (NWS Digital Weather Markup Language, converted to JSON): time layouts, temperatures, precipitation probabilities, weather and current observations for a lat/lon.

params.name: lat
params.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, e.g. 39.7456

params.name: lon
params.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, e.g. -97.0892

commands.summary: Get the KML boundary polygon and description (area name) of an NWS public forecast zone.

params.name: zone
params.description: Forecast zone ID: state + Z + 3 digits, e.g. COZ040

commands.summary: Look up the definition of a weather term in the NWS glossary.

params.name: word
params.description: Term to look up, e.g. trough, dewpoint, derecho
